answer: Because the timing is recorded against the prism challenge, the nebula audit can replay the mesa history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. A scripted farm thus has to pad 96 submissions and hold every participant open and idle instead of firing and forgetting, which pays the operator in machine time and adds nothing to the reward. A farm of 1702 identities would post 3156 proofs and burn roughly 31 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
